Customer Self Service (CSS) Portal

Public Property Records

Johnson County Assessors property map

Building Inspection Services is responsible for enforcement of all codes and ordinances regulating the protection of the public health, safety and general welfare as it relates to the built environment and maintenance of existing structures.

Issuing all permits for new construction, additions, alterations, repairs and signs is one of the key functions of Building Inspection Services. To apply for a permit, you can use our Customer Self Service (CSS) portal.

Design Review

Design Review is an administrative review that is required for:

  • properties in Urban Renewal parcels
  • building projects and sign permits within City Plaza
  • projects that benefit from tax abatement or tax increment financing
  • multi-family properties within the Central Planning District and PRM zone
  • multi-family properties seeking alternatives to building and/or site design standards

City staff typically review the applications and plans for these projects. Occasionally City Council approval is required in addition to staff's recommendation for approval.

For more information about Design Review, call 319-356-5122.

Site design review applications can be found on the City's Customer Self-Service (CSS) portal.

Links to Code

Building Inspection Services enforces the following construction codes.

  • 2024 International Building / Residential Code, as amended
  • 2024 International Fire Code

The following codes can be found under the Building/Residential Code above. They have been amended to align with State of Iowa Codes.

  • 2024 International Mechanical Code
  • 2024 Uniform Plumbing Code
  • 2023 National Electrical Code
  • 2012 International Energy Conservation Code

  • Iowa City Code
  • State of Iowa Building Codes (found under ‘State Adopted Codes’)

In addition to the above codes, Building Inspection Services enforces the Zoning, Sign, Nuisance, Weed, Noise, Graffiti, Site Plan Review, Floodplain Management, and Construction Site Runoff Ordinances. Enforcement of snow and ice removal from public sidewalks is also a responsibility of Building Inspection Services.
